title: Edge Lens: comparative performance ledger for model variants and routes
creator: Ana Rodriguez
description: Design a compact comparative ledger (Edge Lens) focused on per-model and per-route comparisons across model variants and rollout groups. The ledger is intended as a focused view for SREs and platform engineers to quickly spot divergence between variants (latency, p50/p95/p99, throughput, token mix, and cost-per-token) and to provide fast links into rollouts and canary controls. This ticket contains UX intents, detailed chart specs, acceptance criteria, and links to prototypes and review artifacts.
goals: Surface meaningful deltas between model variants and routes within a single compact card
Make cost impact per-1000-tokens and relative token mix visible alongside latency quantiles
Enable fast triage actions (open rollout, compare traces, pin variant) from each ledger row
Support narrow screen widths (console sidebar open) and dense SRE workflows
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Visual density vs. clarity: choose sparklines + micro-quantile glyphs instead of full-size charts to keep ledger compact
Latency bins should be computed client-side from telemetry rollups to avoid extra API calls when switching comparisons
Cost estimates are approximate (derived from per-model unit cost * token count) and need clear disclosure copy
Do not show raw request payloads in ledger — link out to trace only for privacy/compliance
chart_specs: Variant-Delta Row: left-aligned small avatar + variant name + rollout tag
Latency Glyph: 3-tier violin-esque micro glyph showing p50/p95/p99; width encodes throughput; tooltip shows exact quantiles and sample size
Throughput Spark: one-line sparkline (1h) with overlay marker for latest 5m average, hover shows requests/sec histogram
Token Mix Mini-Sankey: embedded 3-segment mini-sankey showing prompt/context/response token ratios; clicking expands to full token-cost breakdown
Cost-per-1k Tokens: compact numeric with color-coded delta vs baseline (green/red) and confidence bar if sample < 500 requests
Batching Efficiency Scatter: small binned dot indicating average batch size and latency; dot size reflects requests in bucket
Anomaly Flag: left-most thin colored bar showing anomaly severity (low/medium/high) driven by historical z-score for p95
Drift Timeline: tiny heat row (24h) showing distribution shifts in prompt length and p95 latency; hover shows earliest spike timestamp
Action Menu: row-level quick actions - Open Rollout, Compare with Baseline, Open Trace, Pin Variant, Create Issue
layout_notes: Compact rows ~56px height for dense scanning, expand-to-row for 320px height with detailed charts
List supports keyboard navigation and multi-select for cross-variant comparison
Responsiveness: for widths <900px switch to stacked microcards (two rows per variant)
Color palette uses existing console token colors; anomaly colors map to alert system definitions
acceptance_criteria: Edge Lens appears under Route -> Performance as a toggleable pane
Rows display variant name, latency glyph, throughput spark, token mix, cost-per-1k, anomaly bar and actions
Clicking Compare opens a diff overlay pre-populated with the two selected variants and their recent 30m traces
Design review sign-off from PM, Eng (runtime) and SRE documented in comments
Prototype links resolve and team can run click-through scenarios during handoff
risks: Telemetry cardinality: too many variants/routes may make the ledger noisy; fallback is to surface top-N by traffic
Approximate cost numbers may confuse finance if shown without confidence bands
Client-side heavy aggregation could increase browser CPU on large workspaces
implementation_notes: Backend: add a compact telemetry rollup endpoint (tcp: /v1/rollups/variant-ledger) returning quantiles + token buckets
Frontend: reuse existing sparkline component and extend for micro-violin glyph
Feature flag: edge-lens-experimental toggled for internal canary teams
Accessibility: ensure glyphs have aria-labels with full quantile numbers
